column1: # Trino token forms for generated compat rows: the text written for each
# token of SqlBase.g4 that is a class of texts. Keywords and punctuation spell
# themselves and need no row. Each note cites the lexer rule in SqlBase.g4,
# which matches keywords in any case (options { caseInsensitive = true; }).

column3: SqlBase.g4:1463 a letter or _, then letters, digits and _
SqlBase.g4:1471 a double-quoted name; "" is a quote in it
SqlBase.g4:1475 a backquoted name, which AstBuilder refuses
SqlBase.g4:1467 a digit, then letters, digits and _, which AstBuilder refuses
SqlBase.g4:1427 a single-quoted string; '' is a quote in it
SqlBase.g4:1431 U& and a single-quoted string
SqlBase.g4:1435 text between $$ and $$, a function definition
SqlBase.g4:1442 X and a quoted string of hex digits
SqlBase.g4:1446 decimal, hex (0X), octal (0O) or binary (0B) digits
SqlBase.g4:1453 digits with a point; 1. would sit against the next word
SqlBase.g4:27 declared in tokens { }, produced only by the CLI's DelimiterLexer
SqlBase.g4:1056 methodName : {isKeyword()}? . ; any keyword, so a reserved one
